title: Windows Server 2022 must be maintained at a supported servicing level.
check_content:
Open "Command Prompt".

Enter "winver.exe".

If the "About Windows" dialog box does not display "Microsoft Windows Server Version 21H1 (Build 20348.xxx)" or greater, this is a finding.

Preview versions must not be used in a production environment.
fixtext: Update the system to a Version 21H2 (Build 20348.xxx) or greater.
VulnDiscussion: Systems at unsupported servicing levels will not receive security updates for new vulnerabilities, which leave them subject to exploitation. Systems must be maintained at a servicing level supported by the vendor with new security updates.
